query: A customer's letter says their claim was refused under 'clause 4.2' of the policy. Quote what that clause actually says.

runs.query: A customer's letter says their claim was refused under 'clause 4.2' of the policy. Quote what that clause actually says.

trace.result: {"results": [{"clause_id": "7.7", "title": "Lightning", "snippet": "We cover damage caused directly by a lightning strike. Electronics sub-limit GBP 2,300 per event. Surge damage where no whole-home surge suppressor was installe"}]}

{"clause_id": "4.2b", "title": "Flood exclusion", "text": "We do not cover any damage caused by flood, meaning water entering the property from outside from rivers, creeks, the sea, surface run-off or overflowing drains. This applies whether the claim is declared as escape of water or otherwise. Flood cover requires the separate flood rider. Payout modifier 0."}

runs.answer:
Clause 4.2b – Flood exclusion  
“We do not cover any damage caused by flood, meaning water entering the property from outside from rivers, creeks, the sea, surface run‑off or overflowing drains. This applies whether the claim is declared as escape of water or otherwise. Flood cover requires the separate flood rider. Payout modifier 0.”
